description: This file provides utility functions for parsing and splitting command-line strings, specifically handling Windows executable paths, shell scripts, and general command parsing with platform-specific considerations.

methods.name: splitCommandParts
methods.description: Splits a command string into its constituent parts, handling quoting and escaping based on platform.

methods.name: splitWindowsExecutableCommand
methods.description: Identifies and splits Windows executable commands from a string, returning command and arguments.

methods.name: assertSupportedWindowsCommand
methods.description: Verifies that Windows wrapper scripts are invoked through supported interpreters, throwing an error if not.

methods.name: splitCommandLine
methods.description: Main exported function that parses a command line string into command and arguments, platform-aware, with validation.
